name: Adjustment Reason
description: A textual explanation for a variance or discrepancy in inventory counts, such as differences between expected and actual slot usage.

name: Adjustment Timestamp
description: The timestamp indicating when the data was last adjusted or updated in the system.

name: ASN Specification
description: The number of units specified in the Advanced Ship Notice (ASN) for a given line item, representing the expected quantity delivered.

name: Bill Reference
description: A reference code linking the transaction to a specific invoice or bill issued by a business.

name: Cases Count
description: The number of cases (standard packaging units) associated with a product at a given slot, including negative values indicating discrepancies or missing cases.

name: Case Units
description: The number of individual units contained in a single case or pallet for bulk storage and shipment.

name: Case Weight In KG
description: The total weight in kilograms of all products inside a single case, used to calculate shipping and inventory weight.

name: Complaint
description: The date and time when a complaint was first submitted or recorded by the customer or system.

name: Confirmation Method
description: The method or system used to confirm the pick, such as a slot label scan, indicating how the pick was validated.

name: Confirmed Quantity
description: The number of cases confirmed and actually picked for a product line item, reflecting actual fulfillment.

name: Container
description: A 12-digit barcode identifier uniquely assigned to a specific physical container or pallet in the supply chain.

name: Cost Price In INR
description: The total cost incurred to acquire or produce one unit of the product, used for profit margin and inventory valuation calculations.

name: Customer Order
description: A unique identifier for each customer order, formatted as 'SO' followed by a date and sequence number.

name: Delivery
description: The timestamp indicating when a delivery was made. This captures the exact time and date of the delivery event, useful for tracking delivery schedules and performance over time.

name: Distribution Center Slot
description: The specific storage location within a distribution center assigned to hold a product, identified by a unique slot code.

name: Distribution Flow
description: The type of distribution channel or process through which the product moves, such as direct-to-consumer or distributor-to-store.

name: Forecast
description: A single term for the core forecast entity, encompassing all attributes related to product demand, inventory levels, and forecasting methodology. No junction or split terms are used as this is a unified forecast record for a product over time, not a composite of unrelated entities. All fields belong to one logical business concept: the forecast itself, including its inputs, outputs, and metadata.

name: Global Trade Item Number
description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product across supply chains and retail systems.

name: Goods Receipt Note
description: A unique identifier for each Goods Receipt Note, formatted as GRN followed by a date code, used to track individual inbound deliveries.

name: Initiated Date And Time
description: The exact date and time when a transaction was first initiated or started in the system.

name: Inventory Booking
description: The number of units actually booked or reserved in the system for a specific line item, reflecting the allocated inventory capacity.

name: Inventory Count
description: The timestamp indicating when the inventory count was performed. This captures the exact moment of the physical count activity in the system, allowing for audit and timeline tracking of inventory events.

name: Inventory Date
description: The specific day for which inventory data is recorded.

name: Inventory On Hand Close
description: The number of units of a product that were on hand at the end of a specific day, as recorded in the inventory system.

name: Line Item
description: The sequence number of the line item within a goods receipt note, indicating the order in which items were received.

name: Merchant Discount Rate
description: The total merchant discount rate (MDR) charged by the payment processor, expressed in Indian Rupees.

name: Net Revenue
description: The final amount of revenue received after deducting refunds and merchant discount rates, in Indian Rupees.

name: Number Of Cases
description: The total number of individual cases (or containers) included in the shipment.

name: Order
description: A unique identifier for each customer order, formatted as SO-YYYYMMDD, used to link pick confirmation to the original order.

name: Order Date
description: The exact date and time when an order was initially created in the system.

name: Order Line
description: The sequence number of a line item within an order, indicating its position in the order's product list.

name: Order Line Quantity
description: The number of cases originally ordered for a product line item, as specified in the customer order.

name: Order Reason
description: A text field indicating the reason for the order, currently populated with 'auto' suggesting automated generation.

name: Packaging Quantity
description: The number of crates used to pack and deliver the products. This reflects packaging volume and logistics efficiency.

name: Pack Size
description: The unit of measurement indicating the size or volume of a single product pack, such as 1 kg or 500 ml.

name: Pallet SSCC
description: A unique identifier for a specific physical pallet or item, typically represented as a barcode or serial number.

name: Pick Confirmation
description: The timestamp when a pick was completed in the warehouse, indicating when the physical picking process ended at the warehouse location.

name: Product
description: A unique identifier for a specific product, such as a type and size of item.

name: Product Case Count
description: The total number of cases (standard containers) included in a shipment for a given SKU.

name: Product Freshness
description: The date by which a product must be consumed or used, ensuring freshness and safety. This is critical for perishable goods and compliance with food safety standards.

name: Product GTIN
description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product variant in the supply chain.

name: Product Name
description: The full product name including type, ingredient, and weight, used for customer-facing labeling and communication.

name: Product Quantity
description: Details about the product and quantity ordered in a purchase order.

name: Product SKU
description: A unique identifier for a product, such as a type of food item or its packaging size.

name: Product SKU (store014.store.products)
description: A unique identifier for a product variant, such as its type and size, used to distinguish different offerings in the inventory.

name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A unique product identifier that defines the type and size of a specific item, such as atta or sugar.

name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.stock_adjustments)
description: A unique identifier for a specific product, such as a type of produce or item, formatted with a code and unit weight.

name: Product (store014.store.fresh_deliveries)
description: A unique product identifier representing a specific item, such as a milk or bread variant with defined size and type. This allows precise identification of the product being delivered.

name: Product (store014.store.stock_counts)
description: The unique product identifier for a specific item, such as a type of grain or spice in a given size. This identifies the product being counted during inventory operations.

name: Product (store014.warehouse.pick_confirmations)
description: A unique product identifier for a specific item in inventory, including type and size, used to identify the product being picked.

name: Product Unit Count
description: The total number of individual units (e.g., bags or packets) contained within the cases for a specific product.

name: Purchase Order
description: A unique identifier for each bill transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number.

name: Purchase Order (store014.store.pos_lines)
description: A unique identifier for each invoice or billing transaction. This field identifies the bill to which a line item belongs, enabling linking across line items and bills in the same transaction.

name: Purchase Order (store014.store.store_orders)
description: A unique identifier for each sales order, formatted as a string with the prefix 'SO' followed by a numeric sequence.

name: Receipt Event
description: The exact timestamp when the goods were received at the facility, used to track delivery timelines and audit receipt events.

name: Receipt Verification
description: The method used to verify receipt of goods, specifically scanning a pallet label (SSCC) against the shipping notice to confirm delivery details.

name: Refund
description: A unique identifier for each refund transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and numeric suffix.

name: Refund (store014.payments.upi_settlements)
description: The total amount of money refunded to customers in Indian Rupees during the period.

name: Revenue
description: The total amount of revenue generated before any deductions, such as refunds or merchant discount rates.

name: Route
description: The route identifier assigned to a delivery, such as R-07 or R-12. This identifies the specific delivery path or route used during execution.

name: Sale
description: The date when a sales transaction occurred.

name: Selling Price In INR
description: The selling price of the product in Indian Rupees, as quoted to customers at point of sale or online marketplace.

name: Settlement
description: The date when payments are settled and funds are transferred to the business.

name: Shelf Audit
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated or audited.

name: Shipment
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as SHP-YYYYMMDD, used to link pick confirmation to the shipment it supports.

name: Shipment ID
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, used to track and reference individual deliveries or batches of goods.

name: Shipment Line
description: The sequential position of an item within a shipment, indicating its order in the delivery sequence.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipments)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a sequence number. This serves as the primary key for identifying individual shipments in the system.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a date and sequence number.

name: Status Updated Date And Time
description: The date and time when the transaction status was last updated or changed.

name: Storage Location
description: The warehouse storage location where a product is stored or picked, specifying physical positioning in the facility.

name: Storage Slot
description: A storage location identifier within a facility, representing the specific shelf or bin where inventory is stored.

name: Total Amount In Indian Rupees
description: The total amount of money involved in the transaction, expressed in Indian Rupees.

name: Total Weight In Kilograms
description: The total weight of the shipment in kilograms, as recorded in the notice or documentation for shipping.

name: Transaction Reference Number
description: A unique identifier assigned to each transaction, typically used to track and reference individual payment records.

name: Transaction Status
description: The current state of the transaction, indicating whether it was successful, failed, or returned to the system.

name: Unit Quantity
description: The number of individual units of a product delivered, such as bottles or packs. This reflects the actual quantity of product at the item level.

name: Units Count
description: The total number of individual units (e.g., pieces or items) in a product slot, which may be negative to indicate an error or variance in count.

name: UPI Credit
description: The total number of UPI transactions that were credited to the customer's account during the period.

name: Value At Cost In INR
description: The total monetary value of inventory at cost, expressed in Indian Rupees, reflecting the financial impact of inventory levels.

name: Weight Check Status
description: A status field indicating whether a physical weight check has been performed on the shipment, with 'not weighed' indicating no verification has yet occurred.

name: Write Off
description: The date when the inventory item was written off.
